name: opengecko-top-market-chart-targets
description: Starter MARKET_CHART_TARGETS manifest for source-backed chart and OHLC sync coverage. Daily and intraday targets cover every seeded chart coin so operators can choose broad historical or minute-level batches from one manifest. These targets are configuration hints only; diagnostics must show live_backed or replay_backed rows before freshness claims are made.

targets.reason: Highest-priority daily market chart and OHLC compatibility target.
Core smart-contract asset daily chart coverage target.
Core L1 daily chart coverage target.
Highest-priority intraday market chart coverage target.
Core smart-contract asset intraday chart coverage target.
Core L1 intraday chart coverage target.

operator_notes: Set MARKET_CHART_BASE_URL to the provider adapter base URL before running bun run market:charts:sync.
Use the daily targets first for broad historical chart/OHLC coverage, then enable the seeded 1m batch once provider and database capacity are proven.
Run GET /diagnostics/market_charts after sync; configured_pending means the target is configured but has no source rows yet.
Do not advertise live market chart freshness until diagnostics report live_backed rows with fresh coverage for the target.
Use stale_source_targets and shallow_source_targets to decide whether a configured provider needs a fresh sync or deeper historical backfill.
